_comment: STUB of camayoc queries/mem_index_since.json (aegis-gshu.10) for bobbin's tests. Same params and columns. camayoc builds cursor = '<recordedAt>|<iri>' with CONCAT; quipu 0.3.27 (bobbin's test engine) evaluates neither CONCAT nor IF/COALESCE, so the fixture data carries the precomputed cursor (aegis:indexCursor, aegis:supersededCursor) and status comes from a UNION. The stub reads the body from rdfs:comment; camayoc uses each entity's own body field.
name: mem_index_since
description: Memory records changed after a cursor '<recordedAt>|<iri>': current ones to upsert, superseded ones to delete. Ordered by cursor; 50 rows plus one overflow sentinel.

params.name: since
params.description: The cursor of the last row of the previous page, '<recordedAt>|<iri>'; empty for a full pull.
